answer: Each new agent identity must post a stake bond before it can earn, so a Sybil fleet needs real capital up front. Rewards accrue only to bonded agents whose work is attested by independent peers, and any identity proven part of a duplicate cluster is slashed. An attacker who spins up hundreds of puppets must fund hundreds of deposits, hoping for a quill of peer trust that linked accounts cannot fake, then watch that capital burn at detection. The falcon's-eye audit of overlap makes every cloned voyage of identities cost more than it yields.
